impressive.en: If you're struck by an idea, you find it particularly interesting or impressive.
impressive.zh: 如果你对某个想法感到 struck，意思就是你觉得它特别有意思或令人印象深刻。

impressive.en: And they filled the city with impressive temples, palaces, and marketplaces.
impressive.zh: 他们用令人惊叹的神庙、宫殿和集市填满了这座城市。

impressive.en: What about you, Phil? Ooh, the most impressive one I've ever seen is actually a whale.
impressive.zh: 你呢，Phil？哦，我见过最令人印象深刻的其实是一头鲸鱼。

impressive.en: This is not to say that Christ the Redeemer is not impressive or not a wonder.
impressive.zh: 这并不是说基督救世主雕像不令人印象深刻或不是奇迹。

impressive.en: If you're struck by an idea or something someone has said, you find it particularly interesting or impressive.
impressive.zh: 如果你对某个想法或别人说的话感到 struck，意思就是你觉得它特别有意思或令人印象深刻。

implicit.en: Presenter Greg Foot spoke to language learning expert Professor Elizabeth Wonnacott, or Liz, about implicit learning.
implicit.zh: 节目主持人 Greg Foot 就内隐学习采访了语言学习专家 Elizabeth Wonnacott 教授（或称 Liz）。

implicit.en: Explicit is the opposite of implicit. It means something is communicated directly.
implicit.zh: 显性（Explicit）与内隐相反。意为某事被直接传达。

implicit.en: And almost everywhere he went, he had something he could count on: the quiet backing, the implicit approval, of France.
implicit.zh: 而且几乎无论他走到哪里，他都有可以倚仗的后台：来自法国的默默支持和默许。

improve.en: One thing I think is really important is improving media literacy and critical thinking.
improve.zh: 我认为真正重要的一件事是提高媒体素养和批判性思维。

improve.en: This can help reduce any accidental mistakes and improve your confidence in any setting.
improve.zh: 这可以帮助减少任何意外的错误，并提高你在任何环境下的自信心。

improve.en: Clear pronunciation is a skill that most people improve through listening and practicing sounds.
improve.zh: 清晰的发音是一种技能，大多数人通过聆听和练习发音来提升它。

improve.en: You can improve over time because there are things to notice, remember, and predict.
improve.zh: 随着时间的推移，你可以进步，因为有东西可以去注意、去记住、去预测。

improve.en: Just like the internet survived the dot-com bubble, AI could continue to grow and improve.
improve.zh: 就像互联网在互联网泡沫中存活下来一样，AI可以继续成长和完善。

image.en: To wrap things up, Vladimir Putin has shaped modern Russia in his image.
image.zh: 总而言之，弗拉基米尔·普京按照自己的形象塑造了现代俄罗斯。

image.en: As I mentioned before, that traditional American Dream had a clear image.
image.zh: 正如我之前提到的，传统的美国梦有一个清晰的画面。

image.en: He also cultivated a very specific image of himself: the fearless leader.
image.zh: 他还精心打造了一个非常独特的个人形象：无所畏惧的领袖。

image.en: And crucially for our story, North Korea is extraordinarily sensitive about its image.
image.zh: 而对我们这个故事来说至关重要的一点是，朝鲜对自己的形象极度敏感。

image.en: Aura farming is when people post highly edited or curated photos online to boost their image.
image.zh: Aura farming 指的是人们在网上发布经过精心修饰、刻意打造的照片，以此来提升自己的形象。

improvement.en: It was not linear. I had really fast improvement at the beginning, but then I hit a learning plateau.
improvement.zh: 它并不是线性的。我在刚开始时进步神速，但随后我遭遇了学习平台期。

improvement.en: Their meta-analysis examining video conferencing for second language learning found positive effects, including improvements in listening and speaking.
improvement.zh: 他们的元分析考察了用于第二语言学习的视频会议，发现了积极的效果，包括听力和口语的提高。

improvement.en: This was a big improvement–after all, it is very similar to what we have today–but it wasn’t perfect.
improvement.zh: 这是一个很大的改进——毕竟，这与我们今天所拥有的非常相似——但它并不完美。

improvement.en: You need to use English to have that improvement.
improvement.zh: 你需要使用英语来获得那种提升。

improvement.en: Once you start speaking, you will notice improvements.
improvement.zh: 一旦你开始说话，你就会注意到进步。

immediately.en: But it’s not something that everyone knows, and it’s not something that’s immediately obvious.
immediately.zh: 但并不是所有人都知道这件事，而且它也不是一眼就能看出来的。

immediately.en: Instead of spending all of their money earned from oil immediately, Norway invests it.
immediately.zh: 挪威没有立即花掉从石油中赚取的所有钱，而是将其投资出去。

immediately.en: Apply language immediately. Don’t wait until you feel ready to use new words or grammar.
immediately.zh: 立即应用语言。不要等到你觉得自己准备好了才去使用新单词或新语法。

immediately.en: You finish your Zoom call and then immediately return to your native language.
immediately.zh: 你结束了Zoom通话，然后立刻回到了你的母语中。

immediately.en: After returning to England in 1836, Darwin did not publish his ideas, at least not immediately.
immediately.zh: 1836年返回英格兰后，Darwin并没有立即发表他的想法，至少没有马上发表。

importance.en: If you underestimate something, you don’t understand the true importance or size of it.
importance.zh: 如果你低估（underestimate）了某事，你就没有真正理解它的重要性或规模大小。

importance.en: A monument’s importance does not increase because millions of people vote for it online.
importance.zh: 一座纪念碑的重要性并不会因为数百万人在线投票而增加。

importance.en: People read those books because of their importance, because of their religious or political significance.
importance.zh: 人们阅读这些书是因为它们的重要性，是因为它们具有宗教或政治意义。

importance.en: And, if you underestimate something, you don’t understand the true importance or size of it.
importance.zh: 而且，如果你低估（underestimate）了某事，你就没有理解它的真正重要性或规模大小。

importance.en: Someone's status is the amount of respect or importance given to them by other people.
importance.zh: 一个人的地位（status）是指他人给予他们的尊重或重视程度。

imagine.en: As you might imagine, for the condottieri, their primary driver was maximising their profit.
imagine.zh: 正如你所想象的那样，对于 condottieri 来说，他们的首要驱动力是最大化利润。

imagine.en: Imagine a woman crouching over a fire, with cooked food in front of her.
imagine.zh: 想象一下一个女人蹲在火堆旁，面前摆着煮熟的食物。

imagine.en: So let’s imagine an example. Imagine you are going to run a marathon.
imagine.zh: 让我们设想一个例子。假设你要去跑马拉松。

imagine.en: So let’s imagine an example. Imagine you are going to run a marathon.
imagine.zh: 让我们设想一个例子。假设你要去跑马拉松。

imagine.en: Imagine you’re trying to tell someone about a trip you went on this weekend.
imagine.zh: 想象一下，你正试图向某人讲述你这个周末去旅行的经历。

imitate.en: And finally, if you mimic somebody or something, you imitate it or copy it.
imitate.zh: 最后，如果你模仿（mimic）某人或某物，你就是在效仿或复制它。

imitate.en: What do you think, Georgie? Well, Phil, I'm no expert, but I imagine they watch the adults around them and kind of copy and imitate what they do.
imitate.zh: 你觉得呢，Georgie？嗯，Phil，我不是专家，但我猜他们会观察周围的成年人，并且有点像模仿他们所做的事情。

imitate.en: Instead of building a different machine for every single task you want to do, he proposed a single machine that could imitate any other machine as long as it was given the correct instructions.
imitate.zh: 他没有针对你想做的每一个单一任务去制造不同的机器，而是提出了一台单一的机器：只要赋予其正确的指令，它就能模仿任何其他的机器。

imitate.en: So, we needed something really creative and really different to think outside of the box, or to let people see themselves in those stories, because people are learning and changing by imitating and modelling and, like, observing others' behaviours and others' actions and emotional reactions to things.
imitate.zh: 所以，我们需要一些真正有创意、真正与众不同的东西来跳出固有思维，或者让人们在这些故事中看到自己，因为人们通过模仿、建模，以及观察别人的行为、别人的行动和对事情的情感反应来学习和改变。

impact.en: OK, then, that is it for today's episode on the environmental impact on AI.
impact.zh: 好了，今天的关于 AI 环境影响的节目就到这里。

impact.en: However, on the street or in open areas, the impact is often much smaller.
impact.zh: 然而，在街头或开阔地区，其影响通常要小得多。

impact.en: And even those that weren’t specifically targeted by the embargo felt its impact.
impact.zh: 甚至那些没有成为禁运特定目标的国家也感受到了其带来的影响。

impact.en: What could happen? In the short term, we might not notice much of an impact.
impact.zh: 可能会发生什么？在短期内，我们可能不会注意到太大的影响。

impact.en: Maybe poetry can't fix everything, but for Kat, it's making an impact for good.
impact.zh: 也许诗歌不能解决所有问题，但对卡特来说，它正在产生积极的影响。

impossible.en: So by mixing control over them, the countries made war between them “materially impossible”.
impossible.zh: 因此，通过共同控制这些材料，这些国家使得彼此之间爆发战争在“物质上成为不可能”。

impossible.en: Leaving the country without permission is illegal and, for most people, essentially impossible.
impossible.zh: 未经许可离开国家是违法的，而且对大多数人来说，基本上也不可能做到。

impossible.en: For most people, it would have been impossible to learn from, especially for a teenager.
impossible.zh: 对大多数人来说，要从中学习是不可能的，对一个青少年来说尤其如此。

impossible.en: Happiness is messy, complicated, and impossible to pin down with complete precision.
impossible.zh: 幸福是凌乱的、复杂的，不可能以完全的精确度去定义。

impossible.en: Jargon can make scientific papers impenetrable, an adjective meaning impossible to understand.
impossible.zh: 行话会使科学论文变得深奥难懂，这是一个意思是无法理解的形容词。

import.en: I mentioned that Britain imports 40% of its food from other producers, mostly in Europe.
import.zh: 我提到过英国 40% 的食物是从其他生产国进口的，其中大部分在欧洲。

import.en: It is the Netherlands. The UK imports £7.6 billion worth of imports, especially vegetables and dairy.
import.zh: 就是荷兰。英国从那里进口了价值 76 亿英镑的商品，尤其是蔬菜和乳制品。

import.en: Aristocratic meals contained enormous quantities of meat, elaborate dishes, sugar, and imported spices.
import.zh: 贵族的餐食包含大量的肉类、精致的菜肴、糖和进口香料。

import.en: Around how many tonnes of cocoa beans were imported to Europe in 2023?
import.zh: 2023年大约有多少吨可可豆进口到欧洲？

import.en: Britain depended on imported food at the time, but German submarines threatened all the ships crossing the Atlantic.
import.zh: 英国当时依赖进口食物，但德国潜艇威胁着所有横跨大西洋的船只。

imaginary.en: To explore this, he invented an imaginary device, we now call the Turing Machine.
imaginary.zh: 为了探讨这一点，他发明了一种假想的装置，我们现在称之为 Turing Machine。

imaginary.en: A goblin, if you don’t know this word, is a sort of imaginary, naughty, often ugly creature that plays tricks on humans.
imaginary.zh: 如果你不知道 goblin 这个词是什么意思，它指的是一种虚构的、调皮捣蛋、通常长得丑陋、喜欢捉弄人类的生物。

imaginary.en: An imaginary angel, representing Lynne's conscience, told her what she should do, while a devil sat on the other shoulder, whispering temptations in her ear.
imaginary.zh: 一个虚构的天使代表着 Lynne 的良知，告诉她应该做什么，而恶魔坐在另一边肩膀上，在她耳边低语着诱惑。

imaginary.en: Here, Michael Rosen responds to an imaginary situation where his toe gets accidentally stepped on by Derek Bousfield, for BBC Radio 4 programme Word of Mouth: Imagine I stepped on your toe and I said, "Oh, Michael, I'm really sorry." And you said, "It's all good."
imaginary.zh: 在这里，Michael Rosen 为 BBC Radio 4 的 Word of Mouth 节目模拟了一个场景，回应他的脚趾被 Derek Bousfield 意外踩到的情况：想象一下我踩到了你的脚趾，我说，“噢，Michael，真的很抱歉。”而你说，“没关系。”

impression.en: He is apparently under the impression that he is speaking with the King of Prussia.
impression.zh: 他显然以为自己正在和普鲁士国王交谈。

impression.en: In this programme, we're exploring people's first impressions of a new culture through its food.
impression.zh: 在这个节目中，我们将通过食物来探讨人们对新文化的第一印象。

impression.en: Your first impression of someone is the opinion you form when meeting them for the first time.
impression.zh: 你对某人的第一印象（first impression）是你第一次见到他时形成的看法。

impression.en: But silence often creates a worse impression than imperfect English.
impression.zh: 但沉默往往比不完美的英语给人留下更糟糕的印象。

impression.en: Your first impression is the opinion you form about someone when you meet them for the first time.
impression.zh: 你的第一印象是指你第一次见到某人时对他形成的看法。

impress.en: Impressed by his notebooks, Ramanujan was introduced to a variety of other prominent mathematicians.
impress.zh: Ramaswamy对他的笔记本印象深刻，于是把Ramanujan介绍给了其他几位杰出的数学家。

impress.en: Bravado is a show of bravery or confidence to impress people.
impress.zh: bravado 指的是为了给人留下深刻印象而表现出的勇敢或自信姿态。

impress.en: As you might imagine, the museum’s curators were astounded and impressed by the boys’ attention to detail.
impress.zh: 正如你所料，博物馆的馆长们对这些孩子对细节的关注感到震惊并留下了深刻印象。

impress.en: Myra was impressed that local politicians take the school children seriously.
impress.zh: Myra对当地政客认真对待学童的态度印象深刻。

impress.en: Will responded with bravado – a show of bravery to impress other people but which often hides someone's true feelings.
impress.zh: Will 用虚张声势(bravado)来回应——这是一种为了给别人留下深刻印象而表现出的勇敢姿态，但往往掩盖着一个人的真实感受。

imagination.en: If Tituba was a witch, then the girls’ fits weren’t imagination; they were evidence.
imagination.zh: 如果蒂图芭是个女巫，那么女孩们的抽搐就不是凭空想象，而是铁证。

imagination.en: Amidst this backdrop of turmoil, two high-profile disappearances captured the public’s imagination and dominated newspaper headlines.
imagination.zh: 在这种动荡的背景下，两起备受瞩目的失踪案引发了公众的无限遐想，并占据了报纸头条。

imagination.en: Yet, the idea captured imaginations for centuries to come.
imagination.zh: 然而，这个想法在接下来的几个世纪里激发了人们的想象力。

imagination.en: But nevertheless, twins continue to capture our imagination, and in this episode we'll be finding out why, using some useful new words and phrases.
imagination.zh: 不过尽管如此，双胞胎仍然吸引着我们的想象力，在本期节目中，我们将借助一些实用的新词汇和短语来探究原因。

imagination.en: Pretty vile stuff, indeed. Now, let’s turn our attention to our last secret society, another enigmatic society that has captured the imagination of many: the Freemasons.
imagination.zh: 确实是非常卑鄙的行径。现在，让我们把注意力转向最后一个秘密社团，另一个激发了无数人想象力的神秘组织：共济会。

immigrant.en: She was the daughter of Indian immigrants and was herself a highly accomplished lawyer.
immigrant.zh: 她是印度移民的女儿，本身就是一位极有成就的律师。

immigrant.en: This isn’t unusual. Most countries around the world have incorporated foods introduced by immigrants.
immigrant.zh: 这并不罕见。世界上大多数国家都融入了由移民引入的食物。

immigrant.en: They want new immigrants to have higher skills, higher incomes, and stronger English language ability.
immigrant.zh: 他们希望新移民具备更高的技能、更高的收入和更强的英语能力。

immigrant.en: There are so many more examples. Chinese immigrants, in particular, transformed the food of Southeast Asia.
immigrant.zh: 还有很多这样的例子。尤其是中国移民，改变了东南亚的食物。

immigrant.en: And also an increasing number of immigrants from other parts of Europe, too.
immigrant.zh: 此外，还有来自欧洲其他地区的移民数量也在不断增加。

immune.en: John says that cortisol, a chemical associated with stress, dampens the immune system.
immune.zh: John说皮质醇是一种与压力相关的化学物质，会削弱免疫系统。

immune.en: Cancer cells switch off the immune system by pretending to be healthy cells.
immune.zh: 癌细胞通过伪装成健康细胞来关闭免疫系统。

immune.en: Vaccines are medicine which protect the human body by making it immune from a certain disease.
immune.zh: 疫苗是一种药物，通过使人体对某种疾病产生免疫力来保护人体。

immune.en: Now, Georgie, is there anything you do to boost your immune system?
immune.zh: 那么，Georgie，你有什么方法来增强你的免疫系统吗？

immune.en: As well as a fight-or-flight response, the stress of not getting enough sleep over a longer period also creates problems including heart disease and a weakened immune system.
immune.zh: 除了“战斗或逃避”反应，长期睡眠不足带来的压力还会引发一系列问题，包括心脏病和免疫系统受损。

immediate.en: The novel caused immediate and widespread offence among Muslim communities around the world.
immediate.zh: 这部小说在世界各地的穆斯林群体中引起了立即且广泛的冒犯感。

immediate.en: And there was immediate confusion among federal employees, the government workers who received the email.
immediate.zh: 收到邮件的联邦雇员也就是政府工作人员中立刻产生了困惑。

immediate.en: You get immediate feedback every time, you know if you were right or wrong.
immediate.zh: 你每次都能得到即时反馈，你知道自己猜对还是猜错。

immediate.en: This non-answer caused immediate alarm, because it stopped short of a clear rejection.
immediate.zh: 这种非回答式的表态立即引起了恐慌，因为它没有明确拒绝。

immediate.en: For several months in the immediate aftermath, the military stepped in to run things, promising elections.
immediate.zh: 在随后的几个月里，军方介入接管了事物，并承诺举行选举。

imply.en: It implies there's some reason that what the speaker is saying is obviously biased towards them.
imply.zh: 它暗示说话人这么说显然是出于某种对自己有利的原因，带有偏向性。

implication.en: What does this mean, and what implications does it have for the future of the country?
implication.zh: 这意味着什么，它对该国的未来又有着怎样的启示？

implication.en: Darwin himself avoided discussing human evolution in detail in his book, but the implications were obvious.
implication.zh: Darwin本人在书中避免详细讨论人类进化，但其中的含义是显而易见的。

implication.en: The implication Milgram drew was a call for structural awareness.
implication.zh: 米尔格拉姆由此得出的启示，是呼吁人们建立起对“结构性因素”的清醒认知。

implication.en: Still, the implication was deeply uncomfortable.
implication.zh: 尽管如此，这种含义令人感到极其不安。

implication.en: It was meant, by some, as a mockery. The implication was that he was too simple, too earthy, too undignified to be a real king.
implication.zh: 在某些人看来，这是一种嘲讽。其潜台词是，他太单纯、太接地气、太没有尊严，不配做一个真正的国王。

implement.en: Similar to the UK, Canada and Australia are also implementing tighter visa policies, specifically for international students.
implement.zh: 与英国类似，加拿大和澳大利亚也在实施更严格的签证政策，特别是针对国际学生。

implement.en: It's what corporate employees describe when they implement policies they find troubling but did not choose and cannot individually change.
implement.zh: 这也是公司员工在执行那些他们觉得有问题、却并非自己选择、也无力单独改变的政策时所描述的状态。

implement.en: Indeed, when I was researching this episode and I wanted to double-check the date that Tony Blair’s government implemented the minimum wage, I googled “Tony Blair minimum wage”.
implement.zh: 事实上，当我为这期节目做调研，想再次确认 Tony Blair 政府实施最低工资的日期时，我谷歌搜索了“Tony Blair minimum wage”。

implement.en: While some of the proposals in this white paper are still being discussed, even as I’m recording this episode, they might have changed since it’s been recorded, others have already been implemented and more changes are scheduled to come into force soon.
implement.zh: 虽然白皮书中的一些提案仍在讨论中——甚至在我录制这期节目时也是如此，而且自我录制以来它们可能已经发生了变化——但其他一些提案已经付诸实施，还有更多变更计划于近期生效。

impose.en: Taxes were imposed, dropped, and then reimposed.
impose.zh: 税收被强征、取消，然后又被重新强征。

impose.en: It might pass resolutions that demand countries stop fighting, impose sanctions that make it harder for aggressive governments to get money or weapons, or send UN peacekeeping forces to protect people in dangerous situations.
impose.zh: 它可能会通过决议要求各国停止战斗，实施制裁使好战政府更难获得资金或武器，或者派遣联合国维和部队在危险情况下保护人民。

impose.en: The US State Department imposed a travel ban on US citizens visiting North Korea shortly after Otto Warmbier’s death, and North Korea currently also has a ban on American citizens entering the country as tourists.
impose.zh: 在奥托·瓦姆比尔去世后不久，美国国务院就对美国公民前往朝鲜实施了旅行禁令，而目前朝鲜也禁止美国公民以游客身份入境。

impose.en: Now, why this is important in the context of nuclear energy is that in the aftermath of the Yom Kippur War, OPEC, or the Organization of Arab Petroleum Exporting Countries, announced that it would impose an embargo on any country that had supported Israel in the war.
impose.zh: 为什么这在核能的背景下很重要呢？因为在赎罪日战争之后，OPEC（即石油输出国组织）宣布对在战争中支持以色列的任何国家实施石油禁运。

impose.en: Its main responsibilities include: trying to prevent wars and violent conflicts between countries; authorising military action if it believes it is necessary to protect peace; imposing sanctions, punishments like trade restrictions, on countries that break international rules; and approving and organising peacekeeping missions, where UN soldiers are sent to conflict areas to protect civilians and help maintain order.
impose.zh: 它的主要职责包括：努力防止国家之间的战争和暴力冲突；在认为必要以维护和平时授权采取军事行动；对违反国际规则的国家实施制裁，即贸易限制等惩罚；以及批准和组织维和任务，派遣联合国士兵前往冲突地区保护平民并帮助维持秩序。

imprison.en: Unsurprisingly, he was found guilty, imprisoned, and his company taken over by the state.
imprison.zh: 毫不意外地，他被判有罪并入狱，他的公司也被国家接管。

imprison.en: They were also charged and imprisoned. Then volunteers came to keep the shop open.
imprison.zh: 她们也遭到起诉并被判入狱。接着志愿者们前来继续维持店铺运营。

imprison.en: They were imprisoned too. Carlile argued, explicitly, that blasphemy law was a political tool.
imprison.zh: 他们也被捕入狱。Carlile 明确指出，亵渎法是一个政治工具。

imprison.en: He cracked down on dissent, exiling or imprisoning those who opposed his vision.
imprison.zh: 他严厉打击异见，将那些反对他愿景的人流放或关入监狱。

imprison.en: If you were loyal, you were rewarded. If you weren’t, you were either exiled, imprisoned, or worse.
imprison.zh: 如果你忠诚，你就会得到奖励。如果你不忠，你就会被流放、监禁，甚至更惨。

immigration.en: This means you can travel freely across Schengen countries without going through immigration checks.
immigration.zh: 这意味着你可以在申根国家之间自由旅行，而无需经过出入境检查。

immigration.en: Several EU countries are also pushing for harder immigration requirements and better border controls.
immigration.zh: 几个欧盟国家也在推动更严苛的移民要求和更好的边境控制。

immigration.en: For most of its modern existence, Italy was a country of emigration, not immigration.
immigration.zh: 在其现代存在的大部分时间里，意大利是一个人口流出国，而不是移民流入国。

immigration.en: This diversity is not an accident. Canada has always been a nation of immigration.
immigration.zh: 这种多元性并非偶然。加拿大一直是一个移民国家。

immigration.en: From one perspective, the fact these countries are changing their immigration policies makes sense.
immigration.zh: 从某种角度来看，这些国家改变移民政策是有道理的。

imperial.en: Together, they formed what many saw as the perfect imperial couple.
imperial.zh: 他们在一起，构成了许多人眼中的完美帝王夫妇。

imperial.en: The Tale of Genji follows the life and relationships of Hikaru Genji, a nobleman living in the Imperial court.
imperial.zh: 《源氏物语》讲述了生活在帝国宫廷中的贵族光源氏（Hikaru Genji）的生活和人际关系。

imperial.en: There are accounts of him creating a brothel inside the imperial palace, complete with hundreds of women and young boys.
imperial.zh: 有记录称他在皇宫内建立了一个妓院，里面有数百名妇女和年轻男孩。

imperial.en: More than 1,000 years ago, the Chinese Imperial Government was using civil service examinations to select officials, government officials.
imperial.zh: 1000多年前，中国古代封建朝廷就曾使用科举考试来选拔官员、政府官员。

imperial.en: An imperial agent but an open-minded explorer.
imperial.zh: 他既是帝国的代理人，又是思想开明的探险家。

immense.en: The Taj Mahal demonstrated the immense wealth and power of the Mughal Empire.
immense.zh: 泰姬陵展示了莫卧儿帝国巨大的财富和权力。

immense.en: They have an immense amount of power, but this power is concentrated in the hands of just 5 countries.
immense.zh: 他们拥有巨大的权力，但这权力却集中在仅仅5个国家的手中。

immense.en: Its armies had marched as far as Vienna, its navy controlled the Mediterranean, and its capital, Constantinople, was a city of immense wealth and influence.
immense.zh: 它的军队曾一路进军维也纳，它的海军控制着地中海，其首都君士坦丁堡是一座拥有巨大财富和影响力的城市。

immerse.en: It’s about creating real life context where language is necessary, and then immersing yourself and practicing intensively.
immerse.zh: 关键在于创造语言必不可少的现实生活情境，然后全身心投入并进行高强度练习。

immerse.en: Immerse yourself intensively. Constant exposure to language is important.
immerse.zh: 让自己进行高强度沉浸。持续接触语言很重要。

immerse.en: I probably should immerse myself more. When I first moved to the island of Shikoku, I did take every opportunity.
immerse.zh: 我可能应该让自己更多地沉浸进去。刚搬到四国岛时，我确实抓住了每一个机会。

immerse.en: But simply being abroad is not enough. You need to interact with English, you need to immerse yourself in English.
immerse.zh: 但仅仅身处国外是不够的。你需要与英语互动，你需要让自己沉浸在英语中。

immerse.en: I don’t read many Japanese books. I could immerse myself in Japanese far more than I currently do, but I don’t really.
immerse.zh: 我不怎么看日本书。我本可以让自己更多地沉浸在日语环境里，但我并没有这么做。

improper.en: Corruption can be understood, in general, as the abuse of power or influence for improper gain.
improper.zh: 总的来说，腐败可以被理解为：为不正当利益而滥用权力或影响力。

improper.en: Corruption is the abuse of power or influence for personal or improper gain, and it can happen in governments, businesses, and organizations around the world.
improper.zh: 腐败是为个人或不正当利益而滥用权力和影响力，它可能发生在世界各地的政府、企业和组织之中。

immunity.en: They brought with them diseases to which the Rapa Nui had no immunity.
immunity.zh: 他们带来了 Rapa Nui 人毫无免疫力的疾病。

immunity.en: Europeans carried diseases like smallpox, which aboriginal people had absolutely no immunity to.
immunity.zh: 欧洲人带来了天花等疾病，而原住民对这些疾病完全没有免疫力。

immunity.en: These communities had no immunity. They were not protected against European diseases, and enormous numbers of people died.
immunity.zh: 这些社群没有任何免疫力。他们对欧洲的疾病毫无抵抗力，无数人因此丧生。

imitation.en: The film Imitation Game focuses on his time at Bletchley Park and the race to break the Enigma Code.
imitation.zh: 电影《模仿游戏》聚焦于他在 Bletchley Park 的岁月以及竞速破解 Enigma 密码的历程。

imperative.en: They also used a lot of short imperative commands, which I mentioned earlier.
imperative.zh: 他们还使用了许多我刚才提到过的简短的祈使指令。

imperative.en: Like the passive voice or the imperative or conditionals, makes language functional.
imperative.zh: 比如被动语态、祈使句或条件句，能使语言发挥实际功能。
